#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Container-Optimized OS: root FS is read-only — put the docker credential
# config on the writable stateful partition or AR auth fails.
export DOCKER_CONFIG=/var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail/docker-config
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG" /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail
# The container runs as a non-root user; the bind-mounted data dir must
# be writable by it (host dirs are root-owned by default).
chmod 0777 /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail
# COS guest firewall defaults to INPUT DROP (only SSH/lo/icmp). Open the
# app ports in the guest chain too — the VPC firewall alone is not enough.
iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || \
  iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT

iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || \
  iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT

docker-credential-gcr configure-docker --registries=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev
docker network create cloudbridge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker rm -f cloudbridge-novaretail caddy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# TLS mode: app is internal-only; Caddy terminates HTTPS on 80/443.
cat > /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail/Caddyfile <<'CADDYEOF'
cloudbridge-novaretail.duckdns.org {
  reverse_proxy cloudbridge-novaretail:8000
}
CADDYEOF
docker run -d --name cloudbridge-novaretail --restart always \
  --network cloudbridge \
  -e NOVA_DB_PATH=/app/data/nova.db \
  -v /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail:/app/data \
  us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/iconic-being-431804-c2/cloudbridge-us/novaretail:latest
mkdir -p /var/lib/caddy-data
docker run -d --name caddy --restart always \
  --network cloudbridge \
  -p 80:80 -p 443:443 \
  -v /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro \
  -v /var/lib/caddy-data:/data \
  caddy:2
